desc: Check if the mapping from S[i] to T[i] is consistent (if S[i] == S[j] then T[i] == T[j]). If not, print -1.
Build a graph where nodes are characters 'a'-'z'. Add directed edge u->v if u appears in S and maps to v in T.
Count the number of edges where u != v (non-identity mappings).
Detect cycles in the graph. Since each node has at most one outgoing edge, we can traverse each component.
Print the sum of non-identity edges and the number of cycles.
